notes.title: The official soundtracks are ready for release!
notes.content:
The official OST of Dies irae ～Interview with Kaziklu Bey～ is now available for purchase as downloadable content!
Please give it a listen, and we hope you enjoy it!
The OST's contents are the same as the "Dominus tecum" CD sold in 2016. The tracks will be provided in .mp3 and .flac format.

notes.title: Dies irae ～Interview with Kaziklu Bey～ is out today!
notes.content: To celebrate the release of Dies irae ～Interview with Kaziklu Bey～, we will be offering the title at a 10% discount from February 28th to March 7th!
